## FLOOWBOX - A/B Test Summarizer
Send test results via webhook.
Code node runs proper Z-test for statistical significance.
Calculates: conversion rates, lift %, confidence level, winner.
GPT-4o interprets in plain English + gives verdict.
Verdict options: implement_B / stick_with_A / run_longer / inconclusive.
Saves to Notion test log + Slack report.
